# Melius

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Creative-agent marketing: offwhite page, gray-dark nav, Reckless 56px hero, yellow Sign In and announcement bar, orange Start for Free at 6px, and a dark pricing island with white plan cards.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (marketing routes, docs.melius.com, and the app.melius.com login and signup cards; nothing submitted; Google, billing and the newsletter were not followed). Themes: light.

Tokens and component notes for Melius (melius.com), captured **2026-11-19**. Desktop is 1440×900. Phone is 390×844. The marketing site paints one light theme, with a dark pricing island. Public routes: `/`, `/pricing`, `/enterprise`, `/about`, `/manifesto`, `/models`, `/brand`, `/contact`, `/creator-program`, `/product/ditto`, `/product/ai-image-generator`, `app.melius.com/login`, `app.melius.com/signup`, and `docs.melius.com`. Signed out the whole time. No form was submitted. No purchase. No OAuth.

Melius marketing is Next.js and Tailwind v4. Colour is a named hex palette on `:root` (`--color-orange` `#f04e23`, `--color-yellow` `#fff78b`, `--color-gray-dark-1` `#202020`, `--color-black` `#0e0e0e`, `--color-white` `#fafafa`). Display is Reckless Standard. UI is Ease Standard. Mono is Geist Mono. The signed-out app paints a dark card over the product canvas. Docs paint Inter on white.

## Typography

### Fonts (from README.md)

Reckless Standard is the marketing display, weight 400, from the Next font stylesheet `398ln9hj2tk0d.css`. Ease Standard is the UI, weight 400, from the same sheet. Geist Mono is the mono. Inter is the docs UI (`--font-inter`). None of the files are shipped. The tokens name the families and fall back to Georgia, system sans, and system mono.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- The signed-in canvas, billing, and Google. `app.melius.com/login` and `/signup` render a card over the product, and the sidebar is visible behind it. Nothing was submitted. Google was not clicked. `/billing` was not opened.
- The phone hero. At 390 the headline is still cycling words in both shots. The settled desktop line is "Create anything you imagine".
- The phone menu. The hamburger click did not open a drawer in the capture. [mobile-home-light-menu-open](screenshots/mobile-home-light-menu-open.png) matches the closed shot.
- The home product menu shot is scrolled. Hover on Product opened the panel and Lenis moved the hero. The panel contents are the live DOM.
- Reckless, Ease and Geist Mono files. The family names are measured. The files are not in this package.
- Pressed states. They are forced pseudo-classes.
- `--color-red-500` in the harvest stayed `lab()`. The token uses the declared hex `#fb2c36`.
- Pricing is a dark island on the same light theme. It is not a second theme.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do paint the page on offwhite and the nav on gray dark 1.** [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Do set the hero in Reckless at 56px.** [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Do use orange for Start for Free and yellow for Sign In, both at 6px.** [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Do keep the announcement bar on the same yellow.** [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Do paint pricing as a dark island with white plan cards.** [pricing-light-default](screenshots/pricing-light-default.png)
- **Don't invent a dark theme for the marketing site.** Pricing is an island. [enterprise-light-default](screenshots/enterprise-light-default.png)
- **Don't submit the login form or follow Google.** [login-light-default](screenshots/login-light-default.png)
- **Don't treat the phone headline as settled copy.** It was still cycling. [mobile-home-light-default](screenshots/mobile-home-light-default.png)
- **Don't ship the Reckless files.** The family name is the token. [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Don't follow billing from a plan card.** [pricing-light-default](screenshots/pricing-light-default.png)
